Frequently
Asked Questions

What are Runable plugins?+

Plugins connect the apps you use to Runable, so you can work with their information and actions in a conversation.

How do I connect an app?+

Choose a plugin and follow its connection flow. Review the requested access before authorizing the connection.

Do I need to choose a plugin for every task?+

Describe what you need, or mention a specific plugin with @. Runable can select the relevant plugin for your request.

Which apps can I connect?+

Explore the connector library for apps such as Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft, Shopify, and more.

Can I disconnect an app?+

You can manage and disconnect your apps from your connection settings.
